description:
## Goal

Implement the twilio-voice concrete transport against audio-tools voice-session interface (defined in research/audio-tools-shared-scenario-contract and built in execute/audio-tools-greenfield-scenario).

## Scope

### Transport
- Twilio Media Streams WebSocket handler (mounted at the endpoint resource-twilio TwiML app points at)
- Per-call session lifecycle: connect, bind to a voice-session, stream until disconnect
- Disconnect/reconnect handling with session resume so a brief drop does not kill the call

### Audio
- Inbound mu-law 8kHz from Twilio resampled to 16kHz PCM for whisper
- Outbound TTS resampled to 8kHz mu-law for Twilio
- Resampler utilities live in the shared audio-tools package, not transport-specific

### Event stream
- Same pub/sub events as browser-voice (transcript deltas, assistant deltas, VAD signals, tool events, barge-in cancels)
- Consumers should not need to know which transport is active

## Constraints

- Transport must implement the abstract voice-session interface — no leaking Twilio-specific shapes into consumers
- One active transport per voice-session (browser observers attached to the same session are read-only)

title: Implement twilio-voice transport in audio-tools
